# CBAMValid Full Content Catalog & Architecture Guide for LLMs

## Platform Positioning & Governance
- **Canonical Product Name:** CBAMValid Exporter Verification Preparation Pack V5
- **Canonical Positioning:** Prepared for Independent Accredited Verification
- **Legal & Regulatory Foundation:** EU Regulation 2023/956, EU ETS AVR 2018/2067, Implementing Regulations (EU) 2023/1776, 2023/1778, and 2025/2546.
- **Commercial Contract:** USD 149 per Exporter Verification Preparation Pack (no subscription, drafts are free, 5 sealed releases included).
- **Support:** info@cbamvalid.com
- **Claim boundary:** Never claims accredited verification opinion, EU approval, customs approval, or registry acceptance.

## Visual System (Institutional Precision, 2026)
- Surfaces: `#FAFAF8` / `#F0EDE8` / `#FFFFFF`
- Ink: `#1A1A1A` / `#4A4A45` / `#8A8A82`
- Forest CTA: `#1B4332` · hover `#2D6A4F` · seal gold `#D4A017`
- QC semantics: blocked `#9B2226` · warning `#BB6B00` · pass `#2D6A4F`
- Type: Source Sans 3 · Source Serif 4 · IBM Plex Mono
- Homepage hero marker: `HERO_STORY_5S` (`components/marketing/hero-story.css`) — 5-second unmanaged→QC Blocked then CBAMValid→Sealed narrative

## Core Public Web Endpoints
- **Homepage:** https://cbamvalid.com/ — Brand-led hero (5-second fail→seal story), positioning, CTAs to register / how-it-works / sample dossier.
- **Product:** https://cbamvalid.com/product — Complete 25-component dossier package breakdown and verifier readiness gates.
- **How It Works:** https://cbamvalid.com/how-it-works — Step-by-step workflow (Setup Scope → Link Evidence → Server Calculation → Generate Sealed Deliverables).
- **Pricing:** https://cbamvalid.com/pricing — Commercial contract (USD 149 per pack), Paddle checkout, multi-release entitlement rules.
- **Sample Dossier:** https://cbamvalid.com/sample-dossier — Interactive browser preview of a sealed V5 verifier dossier.
- **Verification:** https://cbamvalid.com/verify — Public KMS signature and document hash verification for accredited verifiers and customs declarants.
- **Methodology:** https://cbamvalid.com/methodology — Deterministic calculation engine rules, rounding policy (`ROUND_HALF_UP`), precursor inclusion, allocation algebra.
- **CN-Code Hub:** https://cbamvalid.com/cn-code — Combined Nomenclature classification search and sector eligibility (Iron & Steel, Aluminum, Cement, Fertilizers, Hydrogen, Electricity).
- **About:** https://cbamvalid.com/about
- **Contact:** https://cbamvalid.com/contact
- **Legal:** https://cbamvalid.com/privacy · https://cbamvalid.com/terms · https://cbamvalid.com/cookie-policy · https://cbamvalid.com/refund-policy · https://cbamvalid.com/legal-notice

## Deliverable Architecture (25 Controlled Components)
1. `CBAMValid Verification Readiness & Evidence Assurance Dossier.pdf` (structured PDF chapters)
2. `Complete Dossier Compilation.pdf` (consolidated technical annexes & operational registers)
3. `Product Scope Assessment.pdf`
4. `CN Code Reasoning.pdf`
5. `Required Data Checklist.pdf`
6. `Installation Monitoring Plan.pdf`
7. `Production Process Map.pdf`
8. `System Boundary Register.pdf`
9. `Source Stream Register.csv`
10. `Emission Source Register.csv`
11. `Measurement and Meter Register.csv`
12. `Activity Data Ledger.csv`
13. `Evidence Register.csv`
14. `Field-to-Evidence Matrix.csv`
15. `Methodology Decision Log.pdf`
16. `Embedded Emissions Calculation Annex.pdf`
17. `Operator Emissions Report.pdf`
18. `Misstatement and Non-Conformity Register.csv`
19. `Corrective Action Log.csv`
20. `O3CI Field Mapping.csv` (registry-compatible structured data export — not official Registry XML)
21. `Calculation Trace.json`
22. `Verifier Workspace.xlsx`
23. `Data Integrity Manifest.json`
24. `Manifest Signature.sig`
25. `Supporting_Evidence/`

## Structural Quality Controls & Fail-Closed Gates
- **Fail-Closed Sealing:** Requires 100% evidence coverage, zero missing material inputs, APPROVED evidence review status, SUPPORTED evidence support status, and reconciled allocation shares.
- **Data Privacy & Tenant Isolation:** User cases, raw evidence files, and sealed reports are encrypted and strictly excluded from public AI indexing (`robots.txt` disallows `/cases/`, `/account/`, `/dashboard/`, `/admin/`, `/cbam/`, `/credits/`, `/reports/`, `/api/`, `/login`, `/register`).
- **Last Updated:** 2026-07-26
